summary_en: Yellow Hat will acquire up to 450,000 shares (approximately 0.5% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for up to 720 million yen via ToSTNeT-3 at 1,600 yen on November 2, 2026, as part of its authorized 6 million share, 7.5 billion yen buyback program authorized on May 8, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On October 30, 2026, Yellow Hat's board of directors authorized an execution of part of its previously announced share buyback program via off-hours trading (ToSTNeT-3). The company will place buy orders at 1,600 yen, the closing price on that date, during the ToSTNeT-3 trading session on the morning of November 2, 2026. The acquisition cap for this execution is 450,000 shares with an upper limit of 720 million yen.

This execution is part of the authorization announced on May 8, 2026, which permits the acquisition of up to 6 million shares for a maximum of 7.5 billion yen through on-exchange market purchases through February 26, 2027. The purchase represents approximately 0.5% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock), calculated as 450,000 divided by approximately 85.6 million shares. All shares acquired under the May authorization are intended for cancellation.

During the execution of this ToSTNeT-3 purchase, the company will temporarily suspend market purchases under its discretionary trading agreement, with the intention to resume such purchases after completion of this block acquisition.
